sys_script.description: Before-update guard on x_casemgmt_case that enforces the forward-transition preconditions of the case state machine. On a status change it invokes the matching natively authored Flow Designer subflow (x_casemgmt.validate_open_transition, validate_in_progress_transition, validate_pending_transition, validate_resolved_transition, validate_closed_transition) synchronously with sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().inForeground(), then re-evaluates the same gate against the in-flight record through x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator and, on failure, calls gs.addErrorMessage() with the verbatim blocking message plus current.setAbortAction(true) so the error surfaces on the form. Order 250 runs after the Closed-terminal (100) and Any-to-Draft (200) prohibition guards and before the side-effect rules (300/400/500). FAIL-CLOSED: the six canonical statuses are an explicit allowlist - Draft passes to the order-200 rule that owns it, the other five are gated here, and any other value (a stale choice, a direct Table API or scripted write such as Approved) is refused with a blocking message and setAbortAction(true) rather than skipping every gate; and validator construction, guard dispatch and verdict-shape validation all run inside one try/catch, so an exception, a malformed verdict, a non-boolean ok or a rejection with no message produces an explicit deny with a sanitized server diagnostic and a generic user message instead of relying on platform exception semantics.
sys_script.name: x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions
